lux_zone.title: Add a constant-illuminance zone
lux_zone.description: One entry per zone. Afterwards you control the zone through the virtual light this integration creates: ON = closed-loop constant illuminance, setting a brightness = manual passthrough. The real light is driven automatically.

data_description.zone_name: Zone name only (e.g. Bathroom) — it becomes the device name.
data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

lux_reconfigure.title: Reconfigure zone
lux_reconfigure.description: Re-bind the dimmable light and illuminance sensor, or rename the zone. The runtime reloads with the new binding. Re-binding clears the calibration curve — run calibration again afterwards.

data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

lux_init.title: Closed-loop control
lux_init.description: Behavior while the light is on. Adjust the target on the 'target illuminance' number entity.

data.auto_turn_off: Auto turn off when ambient meets target

data_description.scan_interval_s: Closed-loop re-evaluation period while the light is on.
data_description.deadband_pct: Adjustments smaller than this are skipped to avoid flicker.
data_description.deadband_lux: Corrections whose illuminance gap is smaller than this are skipped to suppress sensor quantisation noise and prevent brightness hunting.
data_description.min_brightness_pct: Lower bound for computed brightness; guards the unstable low-end LED region.
data_description.auto_turn_off: Turn the light off after two consecutive cycles with ambient at or above target.

data_description.calibrate_step_pct: Sweep step during calibration (5 = fine, 10 = coarse; auto-upgrades to 10 after repeated timeouts).
data_description.manual_slope: Fallback linear curve (added lux per 1% brightness) when no calibration has been run; 0 disables.
data_description.link_group: Zones sharing the same label act as one lighting space: ambient estimates deduct the other lights' contribution (cross curves from calibration when available, otherwise approximated). Leave empty to disable.
data_description.cross_fade: Share of the other light's calibrated contribution counted for this sensor when no cross curve exists (0.1 to 1.0).
data_description.max_step_pct: Cap on brightness change per closed-loop decision; large corrections approach the target in steps. Off decisions are not limited.

anl_init.title: Time anchors
anl_init.description: Fixed-time fields apply when an anchor mode is fixed; the offset applies to sunset/sunrise modes (unused fields are ignored). Transition duration 0 = instant switch. Lights are changed via reconfigure (unique id is bound to the light set).

data.sun_entity: Sun entity (default: built-in sun.sun; custom entities need next_rising / next_setting attributes)
data.end_transition: Night end transition duration (minutes, 0 = off; only applies when daytime mode is enabled)

calibrate.name: Start calibration
calibrate.description: Run the automatic curve calibration sweep: the light steps 0→100% and back — stay out of the bathroom while it runs. The default 5% step takes about 15-40 minutes total (up to over an hour — about 1 h 20 min at worst — when sensor updates lag); fine 2%/3% sweeps can take 2-3 hours at worst (including sensor reporting waits). Only one zone per bathroom can calibrate at a time: without a target the first calibratable zone starts (others are skipped and logged); with a target the call raises when it matches no zone or is blocked by the calibration mutex.

trigger_now.name: Trigger now
trigger_now.description: Re-anchor every night-light group now: clear manual overrides and re-apply the current band's parameters. Lights taken over by daytime constant-illuminance get the virtual lux light ensured on, with no daytime parameters sent to those lights; other lights in the same group keep being directly controlled by daytime parameters (skipped when every taken-over light is off and only-when-on is set).
